rules.description: badhttp: /compress/bomb flood (2026-10-15 onward): millions of fake-browser user agents through residential proxies, one request per IP, each billed as a Worker invocation. Matches the claimed User-Agent (case-insensitively since 2026-10-23); curl-like clients are unaffected.

badhttp: /compress/bomb with any ?size= value other than the exact strings 1-8 needs the documented opt-in header x-badhttp-bomb: accept (2026-10-23; every repeated value must be in the set). Independent of the user agent: a flood that changes its browser string still gets 403 here for ?size=32 unless it also sends the header. The default and ?size= 1-8 are unaffected.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/compress/bomb" and any(http.request.uri.args.names[*] == "size") and not all(http.request.uri.args["size"][*] in {"1" "2" "3" "4" "5" "6" "7" "8"}) and not any(http.request.headers["x-badhttp-bomb"][*] == "accept"))
